name: red-01-ownership-behavior
purpose: BEHAVIORAL RED before any C010 production code exists: the ten behavioral test files run against the retained NAIVE stub (evidence\red\stub\server.cjs: role-only checks, no lease ownership, distinct foreign/absent answers, public state, mass assignment, partial batches, no commit-time recheck). They must fail on assertions about the specified behavior (a foreign read answers 200 instead of the uniform 404 TARGET_NOT_FOUND, lists show every lease, ...), not on a missing module.

notOk: there is no public state route and no anonymous API answer contains an owner subject or a resource id
the public assets and the fixed scope answer without a token and say that no state is public
a missing, malformed, forged or expired credential is refused with its typed 401 on every route, public or not, and never read as anonymous
the role table is deny by default: a visitor and the operator reach no lease route, a conductor and a visitor reach no operator route
every identity may ask who the server thinks it is, and the answer is the verified subject and role, never a claim
a batch of own targets is applied as a whole, in order
one foreign target anywhere in a batch refuses the whole batch with the uniform refusal and no effect, for every operation and every position
a batch that fails on a conflict of its own targets is refused as a whole with 409 and no effect
a batch may span several leases of the same conductor, and one foreign lease among them still refuses all
a malformed batch is refused by its shape before any target is looked at
an export names a run of its own lease; a foreign run and a run of another own lease are refused, and deleting the run removes its exports
cancel and update follow the state of the run: a second cancel and an update of a cancelled run are conflicts with no effect
ending a lease removes it with every resource, answers like an absent lease afterwards and leaves the other conductor untouched
a lease whose lifetime is over reaches nothing, although the token of its owner is still valid, and it answers like an absent lease
a lease that ends while requests wait in the queue gives them no effect: ended first, refused after
a lease that expires while a request waits gives that request no effect
a token that expires while a request waits gives a typed 401 and no effect
a lease that moves to another owner while a request waits gives that request no effect, and the new owner reaches it while the old owner does not
concurrent creates, reads, ends and rival attempts on one lease settle consistently, and the other conductor never has an effect
mass assignment of an owner, a role, a lease or any server-owned field is refused by name on every route that takes a body, and no owner ever changes
a lease cannot be transferred: no route, verb, body, query or header moves it, and every attempt is refused with no effect
a claimed owner, lease or subject in a header is ignored: the same request with and without them gives the same answer, and is reported by name
a raw request whose body claims an owner is refused before any effect, with the connection closed
path tricks (dot segments, encoded and double encoded slashes, case, trailing characters, look-alikes, long ids, absolute form) never reach another lease
a plain foreign id answers the one uniform refusal that no trick may beat, and an absent id answers the same bytes
guessable sequential ids give an attacker nothing: every guessed id of every kind in the neighbouring range is refused or is its own
method override headers are never obeyed: the real method decides, for an own and for a foreign target
methods outside the route table are refused with the allowed list, for an own, a foreign and an absent target alike
another conductor's lease cannot be reached with read (GET): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's runs cannot be reached with list (GET): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's scratches cannot be reached with list (GET): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's exports cannot be reached with list (GET): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's run cannot be reached with create (POST): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's scratch cannot be reached with create (POST): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's export cannot be reached with create (POST): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's run cannot be reached with read (GET): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's scratch cannot be reached with read (GET): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's export cannot be reached with read (GET): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's run cannot be reached with update (PATCH): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's scratch cannot be reached with update (PATCH): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's run cannot be reached with cancel (POST): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's run cannot be reached with delete (DELETE): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's scratch cannot be reached with delete (DELETE): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's export cannot be reached with delete (DELETE): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
another conductor's lease cannot be reached with end (DELETE): the same request by every other identity changes nothing
the owner of a lease is the subject of the verified token: a lease created by conductor-b is not reachable by conductor-a
a conductor lists only its own leases and the total counts only them
lists of every kind, pages, searches, filters and sorts contain only the caller's items and its own totals
the answers to one conductor do not change when the other conductor changes its own resources
a list query that names an owner, a lease, a method or anything outside the closed vocabulary is refused with no effect
a route that takes no query refuses one, whoever asks
the operator reads the metadata of every live lease and nothing else: owner, expiry and counts, never an id, a name or a content of a resource
the operator view lists only live leases, pages them and refuses every other query
every operator read is itself audited, and a refused attempt by the operator is audited with the server-derived subject
the audit view is for the operator only and never shows client-supplied text
one identity cannot evict another identity's audit records: every subject has its own ring and anonymous refusals have a separate one
a conductor that fills its share gets 409 OWNER_QUOTA_FULL with no effect, and the other conductor and the operator are not affected
the shares of all conductors always fit: whatever one holds, the state never exceeds the sum of the shares and the others keep theirs
an expired lease and an ended lease give their share back
the limits are checked when the server is built: a share that is not a positive integer or an unknown limit is refused
